vr1102d.title: Sony MZ-E520 MD Walkman Portable MiniDisc Player Silver Blue Remote Charger
vr1102d.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vr1102d.details: Sony MZ-E520 MD Walkman portable MiniDisc player in silver with blue accents. Condition: there are scratches and scuffs from use, as shown in the photos. Operation was checked and it works. Included, as shown in the first photo: the player, a wired remote control, a Sony NH-10WM rechargeable gum-type Ni-MH battery, a battery charger with a built-in AC plug and one blue MiniDisc. No earphones are shown in the photos and none are included. This is a playback-only player and does not record. Please see the photos for the exact condition and the included items.
